title: ECCS bench (P601)
description: The reactor core cooling board: RHR / LPCI and low pressure core spray for divisions I and II with their pump and valve switches and red/green lamps, flow and pressure meters, the mimic, and the ADS / SRV section.
source: CR-PANELS-BWR-RESEARCH.md boards 4 and 6 (GE P601 reactor core cooling; ADS switches of the BWR/4 manual)
todo: Valve switches are rotary selectors with a green and a red lamp each; a valve symbol with an embedded lamp (research board 4, Missing) would fold the mimic symbol and the two lamps together.
RHR is shown for the LPCI mode (blue) and core spray (green); the other modes (pool cooling, spray, shutdown cooling) are valves on the bench but have no mimic path of their own yet.

config.Text: DIV I  RHR A / CORE SPRAY A
DIV II  RHR B / CORE SPRAY B
